question: The Harry Messel Award was given to Bibhab Kumar Talukdar for his conservation leadership in October 2024 by the _________________________.
solution: The correct answer is __**Species Survival Commission**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Species Survival Commission (SSC)** is a part of the **International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN).** • It is a **global network of conservation experts** that focuses on improving the status of species and ensuring their survival. • The **Harry Messel Award** is given by the SSC to individuals who demonstrate **exceptional leadership in species conservation efforts.** • **Bibhab Kumar Talukdar**, a noted conservationist from India, was awarded the **Harry Messel Award** in October 2024 for his contributions to species conservation, including his work with **rhinoceroses** and other critically endangered species. • The SSC's efforts include engaging specialists across the globe to work on specific species groups, ecosystems, and conservation challenges.
